description: Which validators must have run for a promotion candidate, ADR-113 decision 3. A validator absent from this table is never consulted by the promotion gate, so every required status check on the default branch ruleset has a row here and a test fails on drift. Each row names the workflow file whose run holds its job, which the provenance check requires. A row with a path_filter may have a path-filter skip of its own job accepted as policy.exempt after the skip is checked against that filter and the candidate's diff (owner decision D26); a row without one has no exemption. Build-tier rows also bind to the npm tarball digest. Issue 5636.
